newsitem.title: USA: Over-the-weekend system RPs total $1.1 bln- Fed.
newsitem.headline: Over-the-weekend system RPs total $1.1 bln- Fed.

text.p: The Federal Reserve's temporary addition of reserves via over the weekend system repurchase agreements totaled $1.1 billion on Friday, a Fed spokeswoman said.
That follows the large $7.649 billion overnight system RPs on Thursday.

Detailing the size of its system repurchase agreements operation is part of the Fed's new daily open market operations announced late last year. The Fed revamped its daily intervention procedure to keep pace with stepped-up market activity.
At 1055 EST/1555 GMT, the overnight bank lending, or federal funds rate, stood at the Fed's 5-1/4-percent target rate.
